breizhdialog.bypass: Direct: bypass Breizh (from the next transmission)
breizhdialog.intro: Your voice goes through Breizh Audio Box, on a PC on the station's local network, before reaching the transceiver. The station keeps the PTT, the TOT and its limiter: if Breizh stops responding, the transmission continues direct, at reduced gain. Microphone audio travels unencrypted on this local network.
clusterandbeeps.link_lost: Link-lost beep (sent if the link drops during my transmission)
clusterandbeeps.roger: Roger beep when I release the PTT
diffusiondialog.intro: Let a few internet listeners without an account on the station hear the transceiver's audio, through a broadcast server: they never reach the station. Private by default (you hand out the address and username), 1 hour by default; during your transmissions, silence unless you tick “Also broadcast my voice”. Any operator can stop a broadcast; it never restarts on its own.
diffusiondialog.title: Live broadcast
diffusiondialog.voice: Also broadcast my voice during my transmissions
freedvdialog.activity_intro: From FreeDV Reporter (qso.freedv.org), read by the station as a passive observer: nothing is sent. Score = chance of reception here (RADE V1): stations transmitting, neighbours decoding.
freedvdialog.intro: FreeDV RADE V1: digital voice decoded by the station. In FreeDV mode, everyone connected hears the decoded voice instead of the transceiver's audio, and silence until a FreeDV signal is locked. The transceiver stays tuned as it is: FreeDV is received in upper sideband (USB or PKTUSB), with a filter of at least 2.4 kHz.
freedvdialog.sequences_help: Likely listening quality, from 1 to 5 stars: median SNR while in sync (5 from +6 dB, 4 from +3, 3 from 0, 2 from −3), one star less if sync holds less than 80 % of the time or is often lost; 2 at most under 3 s. The station does not record the voice.

diffusion.warning: You are about to rebroadcast your transceiver's audio on the internet, to listeners without an account on the station. Thousands of online SDRs already do this, but what you broadcast is YOUR responsibility. Outside the station's allowed bands, listeners hear nothing, unless the setting “Also broadcast outside the allowed bands” is on. During your transmissions, your voice is broadcast only if you tick “Also broadcast my voice”. Continue?
